data.one_liner: Apply OpenGL fragment shader filters to images with preview widgets.
data.what_it_does: Applies various OpenGL/SPIR-V fragment shader filters to images, supports filter pipelines, lookup tables, and includes preview widgets like ImageShaderPreview.
use_when: You need to apply GPU-accelerated image filters like brightness, contrast, blur, or lookup tables.
You want to render filtered images in real-time inside Flutter widgets.
avoid_when: You only need basic image loading or caching without complex shaders.
Your target platform does not support the required graphics backend capabilities.
strengths: Wide selection of pre-built GPUImage-based shaders.
Supports grouped filter pipelines and custom shaders.
weaknesses: Platform-specific rendering issues may occur depending on Android/iOS versions.
Requires managing texture sources and configurations manually.
data.setup_notes: Uses OpenGL fragment shaders and supports code generation via build_runner for custom/bunch configurations.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want pure Dart CPU-based image manipulation instead of GPU-accelerated shaders.
